text:
Nina (PM): kicking off a rollout plan for region-aware routing + tenant opt-in. main goals: low-risk launch, clear telemetry, automated fallback.

Carlos (Backend): proposed stages: us-central -> eu-north -> ap-east. tiny canary (0.5%) for 4h, then 3% for 12h, then 20% if stable.

Theo (FE): console UX: add opt-in toggle per tenant with tooltip + 'request early access' CTA. default OFF for managed customers.

Aisha (ML): canary QA: enable shadow inference paired with live responses. run evals every 15m against the QA corpus and send alerts if any metric regresses.

Jordan (ProdOps): telemetry required: event names: flag.eval, flag.fallback, tenant.opt_in, eval.alert. low-cardinality tags: region, tenant_tier, model_variant. retention 90d for rollout traces.

Carlos (Backend): rough flag json (example):
```json
{"flag":"region_routing_v3","stages":[{"region":"us-central-1","pct":0.5,"duration":"4h"},{"region":"us-central-1","pct":3,"duration":"12h"},{"region":"us-central-1","pct":20,"duration":"24h"},{"region":"eu-north-1","pct":3,"duration":"24h"},{"region":"ap-east-1","pct":3,"duration":"24h"}],"fallback":"route-default","opt_in":"per-tenant"}
```

Nina (PM): quality gates (all must pass to progress): 1) p95 latency within +120ms of baseline. 2) error rate <0.8%. 3) ML eval deltas within thresholds (Aisha to provide numbers).

Aisha (ML): thresholds: response-quality delta <= 1.5pp, hallucination increase <= 0.4pp, token growth <= 8%. fail if any threshold crossed in two consecutive eval intervals.

Jordan (ProdOps): SLO alerts: if p95 > threshold for 10m OR error rate > threshold for 5m -> auto-fallback to variant 'route-default' and page oncall. Fallback events should be idempotent and logged.

Theo (FE): need copy for opt-in emails and console disclaimer. also add 'preview results' for tenants so they can try on a small sample before opting in.

Carlos (Backend): rollout automation plan: runbook steps + automatic pause between stages. cli: `rrctl rollout start --flag region_routing_v3 --owners @nina @carlos --dry-run`

pager-bot: Rollout job queued by Carlos at 2025-11-03T09:00:00Z. Mode: dry-run.

Nina (PM): customer comms: template for (a) invited early opt-ins, (b) general GA note, (c) rollback notice. Jordan will own sending.

Jordan (ProdOps): watch rota: owners on-call for first 48h after each region goes >3% traffic. schedule watch calls and a shorter 2h sync after the 0.5% stage.

Aisha (ML): set up side-by-side diffs for top 50 customer prompts during canary. produce automated report every 30m and flag anomalous language shifts.

Carlos (Backend): emergency rollback ladder: immediate rollback if errors >=1% for 5m; soft-throttle to 10% if p95 > 2x baseline for 30m; manual pause otherwise.

Theo (FE): will hide opt-in toggle for tenants with regulatory flags until legal approves.

Nina (PM): launch checklist recap: flag config ready, dashboards + alerts in place, eval harness live, opt-in UI + comms ready, SRE + ProdOps on rotation. signoff required from Eng, SRE, ML, and Legal.

Carlos (Backend): ack, I'll push config to staging and run the dry-run.

Jordan (ProdOps): ack, will create dashboard links and pre-populate watch calendar invites.

Aisha (ML): ack, I'll wire the eval alerts and post links to reports in the rollout doc.

Theo (FE): ack, I'll land the toggle behind a feature flag.

Nina (PM): great. tagging this thread as canonical for the rollout plan. update here with any deviations. :thumbsup:

Carlos (Backend): starting dry-run now.
